apihelp-query+coordinates-summary: Soo celi isku duwayaasha bogagga la bixiyay.
apihelp-query+coordinates-param-limit: Imisa isku duwayaal  ayaa la soo celinayaa.
apihelp-query+coordinates-param-prop: Guryaha dheeraadka ah ee isku duwayaasha ee la soo celinayo. (Guryaha mar walba la soo celiyo: <var>lat</var>, <var>lon</var>, iyo mid ka mid ah <var>primary</var> ama <var>secondary</var> oo ah calaamad boolean ah.)
apihelp-query+coordinates-paramvalue-pro: Nooca shayga ay isku-duwayaashu tilmaamayaan. Faahfaahin ka eeg [[mw:Special:MyLanguage/Extension:GeoData#Usage]].
Qiyaasta cabbirka shayga oo mitir ahaan.
Koodhka dalka ee ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (tusaale: <samp>US</samp> ama <samp>RU</samp>).
Koodhka gobolka ee ISO 3166-2 (qaybta koodhka ee ka dambeysa xariiqda; tusaale: <samp>FL</samp> ama <samp>MOS</samp>).

Jidhka dhulka ee isku duwayaashu ku saleysan yihiin (tusaale: <samp>moon</samp> ama <samp>pluto</samp>). Haddii aan la cayimin, waxay ku saleysan yihiin Dhulka. Faahfaahin ka eeg [[mw:Special:MyLanguage/Extension:GeoData#Glossary]].
apihelp-query+coordinates-param-primary: Nooca isku-duwayaasha ee la soo celinayo.
apihelp-query+coordinates-paramvalue-pri: Goobta mawduuca maqaalka. Cinwaan kasta wuxuu yeelan karaa ugu badnaan hal isku duwayaal oo aasaasi ah.
Goobta shay lagu xusay maqaalka. Cinwaan wuxuu yeelan karaa tiro kasta oo isku duwayaal ah oo labaad.
Soo celi iskubduwayaasha aasaasiga ah iyo kuwa labaad labadaba.
